head: World Heritage Sites app Worldmark stamps a passport for each visit
dek: Worldmark: Heritage Passport is a new 1.99-dollar iPhone app that tracks the UNESCO World Heritage Sites you visit and fills each country's stamp with colour as you go. It was #67 among paid Travel apps on the US App Store on 23 November.
details: A map shows 1,273 sites with filters and a card for each. You mark a visit with one tap and can add companions, notes, a rating and up to four photos; a timeline lists your trips, and you can export your passport. The maker, Yao Guo, says the app is not linked to or endorsed by UNESCO and collects no data.
means: If you collect places when you travel, this keeps a record of the World Heritage Sites you've seen for a one-off price.
todo: Find Worldmark: Heritage Passport on the App Store; it costs 1.99 dollars, with no in-app purchases listed.
thumb_words: A PASSPORT FOR WORLD HERITAGE SITES
